mapper.select: SELECT gc.provider, gc.collateral_ratio, gc.max_deposit, gc.senior_debt_ratio_limit, COALESCE(hf.loan_linked_required_yn, FALSE) AS requires_loan_link, (CASE WHEN hf.updated_at IS NOT NULL AND hf.updated_at > gc.updated_at THEN hf.updated_at ELSE gc.updated_at END) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS updated_at FROM guarantee_criteria gc LEFT JOIN hf_criteria hf ON hf.guarantee_id = gc.guarantee_id AND gc.provider = 'HF' ORDER BY gc.guarantee_id

SELECT r.premium_rate_id, gc.provider, r.house_type, r.deposit_min, r.deposit_max, r.debt_ratio_min, r.debt_ratio_max, r.premium_rate, r.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS updated_at FROM guarantee_premium_rate r JOIN guarantee_criteria gc ON gc.guarantee_id = r.guarantee_id ORDER BY gc.guarantee_id, r.house_type, r.deposit_min, r.debt_ratio_min, r.premium_rate_id

SELECT lr.regulation_id, lr.house_type, lr.region_type, lr.deposit_ratio_limit, lr.guarantee_cap_no_house, lr.guarantee_cap_one_house, lr.dsr_limit, lr.stress_dsr_rate, lr.dti_limit, lr.effective_date FROM loan_regulation lr ORDER BY lr.effective_date DESC, lr.regulation_id DESC
SELECT rc.negative_equity_ratio, rc.caution_lease_ratio, rc.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS updated_at FROM risk_criteria rc ORDER BY rc.risk_criteria_id LIMIT 1
